assessed_by: RES-720 implementation (Claude Code); requires human review in the RES-720 PR
blockers: measurement-data rights: no dataset-specific grant, data-availability statement or originating study identifies who owns the original Noptel CMP3 / Musclelab recording; the repository-wide MIT file is a software license by the package author and does not by itself establish rights to the underlying measurements (RES-719 Gate 0)
participant consent: no consent or ethics statement is published for the recorded athlete

minor status: the athlete is described only as a 'youth basketball player'; minor status cannot be excluded, so privacy rule 5 (aggregate-only, no individual record as a task) applies even after any admission
dataset_specific_terms: None found. README.md, DESCRIPTION, R/data-laser-gun.R (man/laser_gun_data.Rd source) and data-raw/laser-gun-data.R at the pinned commit contain no data-specific license, consent or data-availability statement.
license_grant_phrase: Permission is hereby granted, free of charge, to any person obtaining a copy
license_scope: Repository-wide MIT license (DESCRIPTION: 'License: MIT + file LICENSE'; author role 'cph'). It grants use, copy and modification of the repository files, including data-raw/laser-gun-data.csv, but is phrased for 'the Software' and is silent on the provenance of measurement data.
local_inspection_basis: The MIT grant at the pinned commit expressly permits copying and modifying the repository files. Local, non-redistributed inspection of the hash-pinned CSV in quarantine, and publication of aggregate pipeline diagnostics with attribution, rely on that grant only. They are not canonical admission.
